title: Smoother, Clearer, Deeper
items: Reliquary: a new Sort button merges stacks and orders your bag by type, rarity, item level and name.
Vault: new Take materials and Take all buttons move things back into your bag in one click, as far as it fits.
Performance: fixed a graphics memory leak that grew with every kill, thralls no longer stutter while following you, and walking under the arches no longer hitches.

Audio: every sound is new, from a full fantasy sound library: spells match their element, enemies have voices, bosses warn you, loot sounds by rarity, footsteps change with the floor. Co-op partners are quieter and danger cuts through the mix.
Full bag: loot no longer chases you around, and the bag-full alert shows once instead of every swing.
Alerts stay at the top of the screen and no longer cover level-up banners.
Loot: stronger affix rolls, far more drops from your own set, better drops the deeper you go, more runes and legendaries. The Atlas shows your real odds.
The map, waystones, Atlas and Codex list the world in descending order.

Ascension Vows: choose your own curses at the Altar (older dead, no flasks, Prelate Echoes...). Your rank is the heat you swear; soul shards unlock new vows and playstyle boons. Seals no longer reset.
Gold sinks: Reforge an affix at the Workbench, or spend a Covenant Seal to wake an Empowered boss for a guaranteed epic-or-better prize.
Loadouts: save rites, runes and weapons together and swap with one click (optional hotkeys in Settings).
Co-op: you play solo unless you make or join a party with a code (Settings > Play together, /party). Partied players can enter the Depths.
Cleaner fights: other players' spell areas are drawn faintly, lingering areas fade to outlines, and danger warnings always draw on top.

HUD: Report a bug button above chat, a clearer elixir belt (click a slot to fill it), new key-art loading screen, fewer panels (Acre Ledger, Character tabs, Grimoire + Legion) and NEW markers when something unlocks.
Gear: helms tint your own hood or helmet instead of floating on top, capes no longer clip on death, and a set summary sits under the paper doll.
Levels now count past 255 (up to 999), and logging in somewhere new stops the old window from saving over you.
Patch notes now show in the launcher, on the website's new Patch notes page, and on the home page.
Fixes: loot icons could draw blank on some graphics cards, tooltips no longer block clicks, and the worn-helm look stays when you change other gear.
Loot no longer flies to you from across the map: walk over an item to pick it up. Anything you leave behind fades after a few minutes (epic and legendary drops after ten).
Covenant counsel cards now light up the part of the screen they explain, like the alchemy belt and the minimap. Settings → Show tips again walks you through them.
Leaner loot: monsters no longer drop ore, bars, logs, bones, seeds or herbs. Gather those instead; you get their value in gold, and gear drops just as often as before.

New Settings → Loot: for each gear rarity, choose to leave it on the ground, auto-loot it straight into your bag, or sell it for gold as it drops. Set pieces, legendaries and upgrades for you are never sold.
